QUOTE: Without asm it XORs with `mbedtls_ct_zero`, a `volatile` global that is 0 (`constant_time.c:29`), so the compiler cannot fold the value at compile time.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says that without asm, `mbedtls_ct_compiler_opaque` XORs with the volatile global `mbedtls_ct_zero`, which holds 0. That covers the fallback and names the global.
